notes.title: Post Launch Update
notes.content:
Hello Rhodians!

We hope you've been having an amazingly disturbing time in the village of Saint Rhodes.

We have read all your much appreciated feedback and reviews, and we've tried to implement as much of it as possible.

This update covers various enhancements to puzzles, lighting requests, and general improvements. 

In detail our first post launch update addresses the following items:

- Dark areas in the town were adjusted. Overall darkness was decreased.
- The shed key is placed on the documents.
- House-doors are less likely slam-shut now.
- George only says “Blocked” line after a couple tries.
- Fixed a bug where the paste could be used multiple times on the catacombs door.
- Shadow entities summon less frequently around the player.
- “Magically locked door objective” is only taken when the player actually checks the catacombs door in Adam’s house.

Warning, the following items contain spoilers about the game:
- [spoiler] Fusebox handle can be taken directly from the swinging chandelier. [/spoiler]
- [spoiler] Sequences 358 and 853 unlock the small-box lock. [/spoiler]
- [spoiler] Room #1 Small-door also gets locked until the player picks Liz’s horn and ashes both. [/spoiler]
- [spoiler] A couple of order numbers were placed on lab-door puzzle hint part. [/spoiler]
- [spoiler] Liz may appear at Room #3 window after taking the Rhodes house key. She may also appear upstairs foyer upon player returns from the well.  [/spoiler]
- [spoiler] Liz foyer appearance scare after taking the Room #1 key improved. Now the light above the phone also flickers to make player more aware about her presence in the hall. [/spoiler]
- [spoiler] The front door slams after taking the handle from the chandelier, if player is walking toward to it and of course it was opened. [/spoiler]

If you have any feedback, feel free to post it on the Steam forums, or join us on Discord!

[url=https://discord.com/invite/iceberginteractive][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418581/ca3dc6df1b93d4f855a828c9aeb4d308275ed29e.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes - OUT NOW!

[h1]ENTER THE HORRIFIC TOWN OF SAINT RHODES TODAY!
[/h1]

[h2]Hello Rhodians,
[/h2]

[b]The big day has finally arrived. 
[/b]

Iceberg Interactive and Stormling Studios are excited to announce the launch of Lunacy: Saint Rhodes, an immersive first-person survival horror game that will send chills down everyone's spine. Now available on Steam,  Lunacy: Saint Rhodes is ready to offer a truly disturbing experience.

In Lunacy: Saint Rhodes, players will feel trapped within a claustrophobic horror movie, as their family’s disturbing history is slowly unravelled. They will discover the secrets behind a tragic family event, and be made to confront their inner demons. All this while navigating the dark and oppressive town of Saint Rhodes, where the feeling of constant unwanted company never goes away. 

See what awaits you in our new release trailer and remember - you are being watched; never alone, never safe. 

[previewyoutube=wUAdBEmwwZo;full][/previewyoutube]

The game is available in English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Dutch, and Brazilian Portuguese!

notes.title: Lunacy: Saint Rhodes Statement
notes.content:
As we inch closer to the release date, we have important news about Lunacy: Saint Rhodes to share with all our highly appreciated wishlisters.

As many of you have noticed, development has taken a long time. For the sake of transparency, we want to share some behind-the-scenes information, which explains part of the situation. 

A couple of years into development, we determined that the current development path was not going to deliver the game we originally envisioned, and we were in danger of needing to cancel the entire project.

To avoid this risk we, as the publishers, decided that it was best for the project, and ultimately for you, our loyal fans, to take over the project and continue working on it with a new development partner -Stormling Studios.

Since this development switch, we have all worked hard to retain the essence of what made the early concept and the history of Saint Rhodes so captivating, and we’re proud of the final result and the fact that the project is now heading towards a close. 

We thank you all for your continued support, and we look forward to welcoming you to the town of Saint Rhodes very soon.

You will not be disappointed…

notes.title: Update on Lunacy: Saint Rhodes' release date.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Some of you may have noticed that we’ve been quiet lately regarding an exact release date. That is because, unfortunately, we have decided to delay the release of Lunacy: Saint Rhodes. 

The reason for that is simple: we don’t feel like the current state of the game lives up to our expectations. We’ve decided to spend more time on a number of aspects of the game, such as monster design, story, lighting, and shaders. We believe this will ultimately make for a better Lunacy.

Below are some examples of what we’ve been working on. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418581/d008bc89f423ed96969f9c589e5c667e1894b317.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418581/a969b86b1eaafadc38456487f270d4a0ae78d92d.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418581/584941dc5b4f557395c3e8da2987598275098aaf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418581/0e61188c2b13b71a969dcc6df5d579afc6802fcc.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418581/db6a39a605c8a8104c5272c92c2e943cb4d0d188.png[/img]

We apologize to those of you who were looking forward to playing Lunacy this holiday season, but trust that the result will be worth the added wait.

It’s back to the grindstone for us now! As for a new release date -- we won’t make the same mistake again, so we’ll revert to “when it’s done™” until further notice.

- The Lunacy team.

notes.title: Lunacy Saint Rhodes: A First Look
notes.content:
To all followers of [b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b],

As most of you are aware, it's been a while since we last brought you news from our studio. We like to be transparent and won't make it a secret that for the majority of 2019 we have been dealing with some challenges that plagued the development of [b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b]. This led to the fact that the game is now planned to release in [i]2020[/i] instead of [i]2019[/i].

That said, we're very happy to let you know that our team has been able to overcome the most pressing issues and has moved back into full gear.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33418581/95e85219c0a1c7ca50ead2130a927439a1e530a3.gif[/img]

While working to resolve our development issues, we discovered that we weren't completely happy with the look & feel of the environments in [b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b]. This is why we spent a good chunk of our time focusing on perfecting the experience of exploring in and around its buildings. Our goal is to make the game feel as if you've stepped into a place that lives and breathes, without it coming across overly designed.

Many hours have been spent on dynamic weather, lighting, foliage, animations and the sound design of the world around you. And we've greatly improved the performance & FPS, which is pretty neat if we say so ourselves! You won't stumble upon cookie cutter interiors, perfectly arranged furniture and organised surfaces during your investigation. The houses of [b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b] will make you wonder: Did someone just leave? Are they still around? Or have they been gone for months already?

[i]It's up to you to discover, if you dare.[/i]

We couldn't be more excited to share the results of our hard work with all of you. Humanity was not meant to come here, yet we want to invite you to step foot into the revamped sights of Saint Rhodes with us.

[b]Click the video below to watch![/b]
https://youtu.be/AW6BSutTeGA
[b]- The Lunacy: Saint Rhodes Team[/b]

notes.title: First-person Survival Horror Game ‘Lunacy: Saint Rhodes’ Will Traumatize Players
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33418581/c07e7653be37ab63d4518f075d47a4c58c9615d6.jpg[/img]

[b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b] is a first-person survival horror game in which you’re never truly safe - as the game watches your every move and adapts to your playing style. The game is slated for release for PC in 2019. 

In [b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b], you seek the truth behind your family’s ghastly murder. Investigate the history of your ancestral home in the town of Saint Rhodes, while fighting to survive what haunts it. The Author, an advanced AI, observes how you play and changes the course of the game based on your actions. You are being watched; never alone, never safe.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dcV2Gnb91xA  
[b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b] is a truly terrifying experience, unravelling the horrific tale of the events in the town of Saint Rhodes. Frightening creatures roam the streets, guided by The Author, as you explore the minutely detailed town, in search of clues to help you survive. No single visit to the town will be the same, with multiple non-linear paths leading to different outcomes.

An early gameplay demo of the game was featured on itch.io and was covered extensively on YouTube having been viewed over 4 million times, most notably by markiplier who noted that [b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b] “is a terrifying experience”. The commercial release promises to be a vast improvement on that early demo.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33418581/0aaaeb82c505b2fb5c21050dfdddd3baea8a45d6.png[/img]

[h1]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes Key Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]An advanced AI watches your every move and ensures that you never really feel safe
[*]True atmospheric horror, enhanced by the beautifully crafted environments of Saint Rhodes
[*]Harrowing storyline involving a family with a dark past
[*]Terrifying enemies, all requiring a different approach
[*]Multiple paths to take and outcomes to experience
[/list]

Stay up-to-date with the latest [b]Lunacy: Saint Rhodes[/b] news and information via the [url=store.steampowered.com/franchise/iceberg]Iceberg Interactive Steam Publisher Page[/url].
